note: Provincial-park campgrounds in the Qu'Appelle Valley along Buffalo Pound Lake, about 20 minutes northeast of Moose Jaw, in three groups: Elmview, Lakeside and Valley by the beach and outdoor pool; Maple Vale, Shady Lane and Trails End about 2.5 km northwest; and the non-electric Lower Chalet loops about 2 km southeast. Lakeside's seven sites sit behind a strip of shoreline trees. Most Elmview and Shady Lane A sites are posted for units of 18 ft or less. --Claude
summary: Keep. 273 campsites (223 nightly: 178 electric incl. 4 accessible, 18 full service, 27 non-electric; 50 seasonal), 15/30/50 A, full service in Valley, rigs to 50 ft, site-specific SKPP booking; winter camping in Elmview to Mar 14. Lakeview confirmed (Lakeside L1-L7 behind shoreline trees); one lakefront lead (Shady Lane B S40/S42). Phone '' -> 1-306-694-3229. Split candidate (three clusters 2-2.5 km apart).
flags: SITES: stored 270 (note prose) -> 273 (223 nightly + 50 seasonal; 2 yurts, Rankins group area, pavilion excluded). 39 nightly sites are posted under 23 ft (Elmview E2/E5-E24 at 18 ft, Shady Lane A S1/S3-S7/S9-S13/S19 at 15-18 ft, Maple Vale M8/M34/M48/M55 at 18 ft and M59 at 20 ft, Valley V12F 20 ft); 147 nightly sites post 23 ft+, 38 are blank.
HOOKUPS: electric 50 added (15/30/50 at Lakeside, Valley, some Maple Vale); water/sewer true confirmed on Valley's 18 nightly full-service sites (V1F-V24F).

WATERFRONT: 'lakeview' kept. Every SKPP row reads 'Near Water - no' (including Lakeside, so the tag is not informative here). Lakeside L1-L7 (50.5973-50.5977,-105.4155..-105.4164, nightly electric 40-50 ft) sit 15-30 m from the shore behind a continuous band of shoreline trees and shrubs: a view. Valley full-service sites are ~90 m from the water behind trees; Lower Chalet ~250 m behind the park road and woods; Elmview, Maple Vale, Shady Lane A and Trails End are inland.

WATERFRONT LEAD (up, imagery only): Shady Lane B nightly sites S40 (50.61329,-105.44596) and S42 (50.61345,-105.44628), 32 ft, sit ~20 m and ~35 m from the lake edge with open grass and a narrow sand strip between (no trees on that side). Shady Lane B's other shore-side sites are seasonal (S41, S43-S59) or behind shrub/reed fringe (S30-S36, 25-55 m). Two nightly sites only; Buffalo Pound is a regulated reservoir and the sand strip may be a shoreline path, so not upgraded - the reviewer may want a ground photo.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: three clusters off the park road, each with its own campground road: (1) Elmview/Lakeside/Valley ~50.5945,-105.4150 (67 sites incl. 6 seasonal); (2) Maple Vale/Shady Lane A/B/Trails End ~50.6105,-105.4455, ~2.4 km NW (181 sites incl. 44 seasonal); (3) Lower Chalet A/B ~50.5807,-105.3888, ~2 km SE of cluster 1 (27 nightly non-electric). All on the same SKPP parkId 290170 booking page (filter by loop).

PIN: no move. Stored 50.5947,-105.4126 sits in the beach/boat-launch parking lot, ~280 m from the Valley centroid (50.5922,-105.4129) and ~290 m from Elmview (50.5946,-105.4167). The SKPP GPS point 50.58528,-105.4228 is the park gate area.
